**Prior Degrees:** Brevet de Technicien Supérieur (Canadian equivalent: second year of cycle 1)

I have been working in the field of metal construction for 9 years now. I started to study in this domain when I was 16 years old, and I did all my studies in apprenticeship. I am passionate about this profession, especially in the field of civil engineering.

My dream would be to open my own engineering office specialized in the dimensioning and the calculation of structural resistance, and to be able to do it internationally.

I have one year left in my engineering cycle, but before that I will work for 2 months at CCWJ (June 2022 to July 2022) to have an experience abroad, to have new contacts, and to learn more about the process I will study (FSW).
My main hobbies are fishing, playing drums, playing sports (soccer, weight training, cycling, and many others), and scuba diving.

#### Project

Since the beginning of my studies I have been working in the field of steel and especially structures, and welding has a very important place in this environment.
